providers.name: Groq
providers.note: Very fast. The free plan has daily request and token caps, so it can run out on a busy day.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.note: Generous free tier and a large context window. Google may use free-tier requests to improve its products.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.note: One key for many models. Free models are limited to a few dozen requests a day, and the free model list changes often; pick one on openrouter.ai/models if this one is gone.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.note: Free mode with rate limits. Free-mode requests may be used for training.

providers.name: Ollama (on this computer)
providers.note: Runs locally: no key, no limits, nothing leaves this computer. Install Ollama, then run: ollama pull llama3.1:8b

providers.name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
providers.note: Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat completions format, such as LM Studio or your own gateway. The key is optional.
